<body>
<style>

  :root{
    --pw-amber:#FF9800;
    --pw-amber-deep:#E07B00;
    --pw-ink:#131311;
    --pw-ink-soft:#1C1C19;
    --pw-surface:#EDEDEA;
    --pw-muted:#6E6E6A;
    --pw-border:#B9B9B4;
    --pw-white:#FFFFFF;
    --pw-good:#2E7D4F;
    --font-h:'Archivo','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;
    --font-b:'Inter',-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif;
  }

  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
  body{
    margin:0;
    background:var(--pw-white);
    color:var(--pw-ink);
    font-family:var(--font-b);
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
    padding-inline:0;
  }
  img{max-width:100%;}

  .wrap{
    max-width:1080px;
    margin:0 auto;
    padding-inline:20px;
  }

  h1,h2,h3,h4{
    font-family:var(--font-h);
    text-transform:uppercase;
    letter-spacing:0.01em;
    margin:0;
    text-wrap:balance;
  }

  a{color:var(--pw-amber-deep);}

  /* ---------- header ---------- */
  header.site{
    position:sticky;
    top:0;
    z-index:50;
    background:var(--pw-ink);
    border-bottom:1px solid #2A2A26;
  }
  .header-inner{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:space-between;
    gap:12px;
    padding-block:12px;
  }
  .brand{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:10px;
  }
  .brand-logo{display:block;width:auto;height:54px;max-width:none;object-fit:contain;flex:none;}
  @media(max-width:559px){.brand-logo{height:44px;}}
  .brand-sub{
    display:none;
    color:#B9B9B4;
    font-size:11px;
    font-weight:600;
    letter-spacing:0.08em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    border-left:1px solid #3A3A36;
    padding-left:10px;
  }
  @media(min-width:560px){ .brand-sub{display:block;} }
  .header-cta{
    display:flex;
    gap:8px;
  }
  .icon-btn{
    display:inline-flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:6px;
    background:var(--pw-amber);
    color:var(--pw-ink);
    font-family:var(--font-h);
    font-weight:800;
    font-size:12px;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    letter-spacing:0.02em;
    text-decoration:none;
    padding:9px 12px;
    border-radius:5px;
    white-space:nowrap;
  }
  .icon-btn:hover{background:var(--pw-amber-deep);color:var(--pw-white);}

  /* ---------- hero ---------- */
  .hero{
    background:
      radial-gradient(ellipse 900px 500px at 80% -10%, rgba(255,152,0,0.18), transparent 60%),
      var(--pw-ink);
    color:var(--pw-white);
    padding-block:44px 40px;
    overflow:hidden;
  }
  .hero-grid{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:1fr;
    gap:34px;
    align-items:center;
  }
  @media(min-width:860px){
    .hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:24px;}
  }
  .eyebrow{
    display:inline-flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:8px;
    background:rgba(255,152,0,0.14);
    border:1px solid rgba(255,152,0,0.4);
    color:var(--pw-amber);
    font-family:var(--font-h);
    font-weight:800;
    font-size:11.5px;
    letter-spacing:0.08em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    padding:7px 12px;
    border-radius:999px;
    margin-bottom:18px;
  }
  .dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--pw-amber);}
  .hero h1{
    font-size:clamp(30px,5.6vw,50px);
    font-weight:900;
    line-height:1.04;
    color:var(--pw-white);
  }
  .hero h1 em{
    font-style:normal;
    color:var(--pw-amber);
  }
  .hero p.lede{
    font-size:16px;
    line-height:1.6;
    color:#D8D8D4;
    max-width:52ch;
    margin-top:16px;
  }
  .hero-ctas{
    display:flex;
    flex-wrap:wrap;
    gap:12px;
    margin-top:26px;
  }
  .btn{
    font-family:var(--font-h);
    font-weight:800;
    font-size:13.5px;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    letter-spacing:0.02em;
    padding:14px 22px;
    border-radius:6px;
    border:none;
    cursor:pointer;
    text-decoration:none;
    display:inline-flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:9px;
  }
  .btn-primary{background:var(--pw-amber);color:var(--pw-ink);}
  .btn-primary:hover{background:var(--pw-amber-deep);color:var(--pw-white);}
  .btn-ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--pw-white);border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.35);}
  .btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--pw-white);}

  .trust-row{
    display:flex;
    flex-wrap:wrap;
    gap:18px;
    margin-top:28px;
    color:#B9B9B4;
    font-size:12.5px;
    font-weight:600;
  }
  .trust-row b{color:var(--pw-white);font-weight:700;}

  /* device art */
  .device-stage{
    display:flex;
    justify-content:center;
  }
  .phone{
    position:relative;
    width:184px;
    height:378px;
    background:linear-gradient(160deg,#3a3a36,#131311 55%);
    border-radius:42px;
    border:2px solid #46463f;
    box-shadow:0 30px 60px -20px rgba(0,0,0,0.6), inset 0 0 0 6px #0d0d0b;
  }
  .phone::before{
    content:"";
    position:absolute;
    inset:10px;
    border-radius:32px;
    background:linear-gradient(200deg,#232320,#0c0c0b 70%);
  }
  .phone .island{
    position:absolute;
    top:22px;left:50%;
    transform:translateX(-50%);
    width:64px;height:19px;
    background:#000;
    border-radius:12px;
  }
  .phone .cam{
    position:absolute;
    top:44px;left:22px;
    width:70px;height:70px;
    background:linear-gradient(160deg,#2c2c28,#131311);
    border-radius:20px;
    border:1px solid #3d3d38;
  }
  .phone .lens{
    position:absolute;
    width:26px;height:26px;
    border-radius:50%;
    background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, #4a4a44, #0a0a09 70%);
    border:1px solid #4a4a44;
  }
  .phone .lens.l1{top:6px;left:6px;}
  .phone .lens.l2{top:6px;right:6px;}
  .phone .lens.l3{bottom:6px;left:6px;}
  .hero-product-img{
    width:100%;
    max-width:640px;
    height:auto;
    display:block;
    margin:0 auto;
    -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 72% 78% at center, #000 62%, transparent 100%);
    mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 72% 78% at center, #000 62%, transparent 100%);
    filter:drop-shadow(0 25px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.45));
  }
  @media(min-width:860px){
    .hero-product-img{max-width:720px;}
  }
  .hero-caption{
    font-size:11px;
    color:#8C8C87;
    margin-top:10px;
    line-height:1.5;
  }
  .glow-badge{
    position:absolute;
    bottom:18px;
    left:50%;
    transform:translateX(-50%);
    background:var(--pw-amber);
    color:var(--pw-ink);
    font-family:var(--font-h);
    font-weight:900;
    font-size:11px;
    letter-spacing:0.04em;
    padding:5px 10px;
    border-radius:999px;
    white-space:nowrap;
  }

  /* countdown */
  .countdown{
    margin-top:30px;
    display:flex;
    gap:10px;
    flex-wrap:wrap;
  }
  .cd-cell{
    background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14);
    border-radius:8px;
    padding:10px 14px;
    min-width:64px;
    text-align:center;
  }
  .cd-num{
    font-family:var(--font-h);
    font-weight:900;
    font-size:22px;
    color:var(--pw-amber);
    font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;
  }
  .cd-label{
    font-size:9.5px;
    letter-spacing:0.08em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    color:#B9B9B4;
    margin-top:2px;
  }
  .launch-live{
    margin-top:30px;
    display:inline-flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:10px;
    background:rgba(46,125,79,0.14);
    border:1px solid rgba(46,125,79,0.5);
    color:#BFE3CC;
    font-size:13px;
    font-weight:600;
    line-height:1.5;
    padding:12px 16px;
    border-radius:10px;
    max-width:52ch;
  }
  .launch-live b{color:var(--pw-white);}
  .launch-live-dot{
    width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;
    background:var(--pw-good);
    flex:none;
    margin-top:2px;
    box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(46,125,79,0.25);
  }
  /* Both .countdown and .launch-live set their own "display" value, which
     otherwise overrides the browser's default [hidden]{display:none} rule
     at equal specificity — these explicit overrides make hiding actually work. */
  .countdown[hidden]{display:none;}
  .launch-live[hidden]{display:none;}

  /* ---------- timeline strip ---------- */
  .strip{
    background:var(--pw-amber);
  }
  .strip-inner{
    display:flex;
    flex-wrap:wrap;
    gap:10px 28px;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    padding-block:12px;
    font-family:var(--font-h);
    font-weight:800;
    font-size:12.5px;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    letter-spacing:0.02em;
    color:var(--pw-ink);
    text-align:center;
  }
  .strip-inner .sep{opacity:0.55;}

  /* ---------- sections ---------- */
  section{padding-block:56px;}
  .section-head{
    max-width:60ch;
    margin-bottom:34px;
  }
  .section-head .kicker{
    display:block;
    color:var(--pw-amber-deep);
    font-family:var(--font-h);
    font-weight:800;
    font-size:11.5px;
    letter-spacing:0.1em;
    margin-bottom:8px;
  }
  .section-head h2{
    font-size:clamp(24px,3.6vw,32px);
    font-weight:900;
    line-height:1.12;
  }
  .section-head p{
    color:var(--pw-muted);
    font-size:15px;
    margin-top:10px;
    line-height:1.6;
  }

  /* product cards */
  .prod-grid{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:1fr;
    gap:18px;
  }
  @media(min-width:720px){ .prod-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;} }
  .prod-card{
    background:var(--pw-surface);
    border:1px solid var(--pw-border);
    border-radius:12px;
    padding:26px;
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    gap:16px;
  }
  .prod-card.featured{
    background:var(--pw-ink);
    border-color:var(--pw-ink);
    color:var(--pw-white);
  }
  .prod-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px;}
  .prod-name{font-size:20px;font-weight:900;}
  .prod-card.featured .prod-name{color:var(--pw-white);}
  .tag-max{
    background:var(--pw-amber);
    color:var(--pw-ink);
    font-family:var(--font-h);
    font-weight:800;
    font-size:10.5px;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    padding:4px 9px;
    border-radius:999px;
    white-space:nowrap;
  }
  .price-row{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:8px;}
  .price{
    font-family:var(--font-h);
    font-weight:900;
    font-size:28px;
  }
  .price-note{
    font-size:11.5px;
    color:var(--pw-muted);
  }
  .prod-card.featured .price-note{color:#B9B9B4;}
  .spec-list{
    list-style:none;
    margin:0;padding:0;
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    gap:8px;
    font-size:13.5px;
  }
  .spec-list li{
    display:flex;
    gap:8px;
    align-items:flex-start;
  }
  .spec-list li::before{
    content:"";
    width:6px;height:6px;
    border-radius:50%;
    background:var(--pw-amber);
    margin-top:6px;
    flex:none;
  }
  .prod-card .btn{margin-top:auto;width:100%;justify-content:center;}


  /* Model-specific render staging; images are promotional concept renders. */
  .cfg-img-wrap{position:relative;overflow:hidden;width:min(100%,300px);height:310px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 38%,#fff 0%,#eee 70%,#ddd 100%);transition:background .25s ease}
  .cfg-img-wrap[data-color="black"]{background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 32%,#fafaf8,#dcdbd8)}
  .cfg-img-wrap[data-color="glacier"]{background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 32%,#fff,#d7e8eb)}
  .cfg-img-wrap[data-color="silver"]{background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 32%,#fff,#e5e3dd)}
  .cfg-img-wrap[data-color="burgundy"]{background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 32%,#fff,#ead9df)}
  .cfg-product-img{max-width:none;width:87%;height:87%;object-fit:contain;mix-blend-mode:multiply}
  .cfg-product-img.is-max{max-width:none;width:105%;height:105%}
  .cfg-model-badge{position:absolute;left:12px;bottom:12px;padding:6px 10px;background:#131311;color:#fff;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;border-radius:999px;letter-spacing:.02em}
  .cfg-size-note{font-size:11px;color:#ddd;text-align:center;margin:-6px 0 0}
  .cfg-price-under-model{font-size:11px;color:inherit;font-weight:800;opacity:.85}
  #cfgCta{min-height:46px}
  .cfg-form-link{color:#fff;font-size:12px;text-align:center;text-underline-offset:3px}
  .swatch{width:44px;height:44px;flex:none}
  .swatch:focus-visible,.seg:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #fff;outline-offset:4px}
  .configurator-visual .visual-note{text-align:center;line-height:1.45;max-width:35ch;color:#d0d0ca;font-size:11.5px;margin:0}
  @media(max-width:480px){.cfg-img-wrap{height:280px}.configurator{gap:24px}.configurator-visual{gap:12px}}

  /* configurator */
  .configurator{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:1fr;
    gap:30px;
    align-items:start;
    background:var(--pw-ink);
    border-radius:16px;
    padding:30px 20px;
    color:var(--pw-white);
  }
  @media(min-width:860px){
    .configurator{grid-template-columns:0.85fr 1.15fr;padding:40px;gap:40px;}
  }
  .configurator-visual{
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    align-items:center;
    gap:16px;
    padding-top:6px;
  }
  .cfg-img-wrap{
    width:240px;
    height:240px;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 42%, #ffffff 0%, #f3f3f0 62%, #e9e9e4 100%);
    border-radius:22px;
    padding:14px;
    box-shadow:0 20px 40px -16px rgba(0,0,0,0.55);
  }
  .cfg-product-img{
    width:100%;
    max-width:212px;
    height:auto;
    display:block;
    mix-blend-mode:multiply;
    transition:opacity 0.25s ease, transform 0.35s ease;
  }
  .cfg-product-img.is-max{
    max-width:230px;
  }
  .cfg-product-img.is-swapping{
    opacity:0;
    transform:scale(0.96);
  }
  @media(min-width:860px){
    .cfg-img-wrap{width:280px;height:280px;}
    .cfg-product-img{max-width:248px;}
    .cfg-product-img.is-max{max-width:268px;}
  }
  .visual-caption{
    font-family:var(--font-h);
    font-weight:800;
    font-size:13px;
    letter-spacing:0.02em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--pw-amber);
    text-align:center;
  }
  .configurator-controls{
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    gap:22px;
  }
  .cfg-label{
    font-family:var(--font-h);
    font-size:11.5px;
    font-weight:800;
    letter-spacing:0.08em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    color:#B9B9B4;
    margin-bottom:10px;
    display:block;
  }
  .seg-group{
    display:flex;
    gap:8px;
    flex-wrap:wrap;
  }
  .seg{
    font-family:var(--font-b);
    font-size:13px;
    font-weight:700;
    color:var(--pw-white);
    background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.16);
    border-radius:8px;
    padding:10px 16px;
    cursor:pointer;
    text-align:center;
    line-height:1.3;
  }
  .seg span{
    display:block;
    font-size:10.5px;
    font-weight:600;
    color:#B9B9B4;
    margin-top:2px;
  }
  .seg.active{
    background:var(--pw-amber);
    border-color:var(--pw-amber);
    color:var(--pw-ink);
  }
  .seg.active span{color:var(--pw-ink);opacity:0.75;}
  .swatch-group{
    display:flex;
    gap:10px;
  }
  .swatch{
    width:34px;height:34px;
    border-radius:50%;
    background:var(--sw);
    border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
    cursor:pointer;
    padding:0;
    position:relative;
  }
  .swatch.active{
    border-color:var(--pw-amber);
    box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--pw-ink), 0 0 0 4px var(--pw-amber);
  }
  .color-name{
    margin-top:8px;
    font-size:12.5px;
    color:#D8D8D4;
    font-weight:600;
  }
  .price-display{
    background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14);
    border-radius:10px;
    padding:16px 18px;
  }
  .price-display-amount{
    font-family:var(--font-h);
    font-weight:900;
    font-size:26px;
    color:var(--pw-amber);
    font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;
  }
  .price-display-note{
    font-size:12px;
    color:#B9B9B4;
    margin-top:4px;
  }
  .cfg-summary{
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    gap:4px;
    background:rgba(255,152,0,0.06);
    border:1px dashed rgba(255,152,0,0.35);
    border-radius:8px;
    padding:12px 14px;
  }
  .cfg-summary-label{
    font-family:var(--font-h);
    font-size:10.5px;
    font-weight:800;
    letter-spacing:0.06em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--pw-amber);
  }
  .cfg-summary-line{
    font-size:13.5px;
    font-weight:700;
    color:var(--pw-white);
  }
  .cfg-summary-offers{
    font-size:11.5px;
    color:#D8D8D4;
  }
  .cfg-summary-offers:empty{display:none;}
  .configurator-controls .btn{width:100%;justify-content:center;}

  .apple-photo-link{
    display:inline-flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:6px;
    font-size:12px;
    font-weight:700;
    color:var(--pw-amber);
    text-decoration:none;
    border-bottom:1px dashed rgba(255,152,0,0.5);
  }
  .apple-photo-link:hover{color:var(--pw-white);}
  .visual-note{
    font-size:11px;
    color:#8C8C87;
    text-align:center;
    max-width:220px;
  }

  .cashback-block{margin-top:4px;}
  .cashback-toggle{
    display:flex;
    justify-content:space-between;
    align-items:center;
    width:100%;
    background:rgba(255,152,0,0.1);
    border:1.5px solid rgba(255,152,0,0.4);
    color:var(--pw-white);
    font-family:var(--font-h);
    font-weight:800;
    font-size:13px;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    letter-spacing:0.02em;
    padding:13px 16px;
    border-radius:8px;
    cursor:pointer;
  }
  .cashback-toggle .amt{color:var(--pw-amber);}
  .cashback-toggle .chev{transition:transform 0.2s ease;font-size:11px;}
  .cashback-toggle[aria-expanded="true"] .chev{transform:rotate(180deg);}
  .cashback-panel{
    margin-top:10px;
    background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14);
    border-radius:10px;
    padding:16px 18px;
    font-size:12.5px;
    color:#D8D8D4;
    line-height:1.6;
  }
  .cashback-panel ul{margin:8px 0;padding-left:18px;}
  .cashback-panel li{margin-bottom:4px;}
  .cashback-panel .src{
    display:block;
    margin-top:10px;
    font-size:11px;
    color:#8C8C87;
  }
  .emi-tenure-row{
    display:flex;
    gap:12px;
    flex-wrap:wrap;
  }
  .emi-tenure-card{
    flex:1;
    min-width:120px;
    background:rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.16);
    border-radius:8px;
    padding:12px 14px;
    text-align:center;
  }
  .emi-tenure-len{
    font-size:11px;
    font-weight:700;
    color:#B9B9B4;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    letter-spacing:0.04em;
  }
  .emi-tenure-amt{
    font-family:var(--font-h);
    font-weight:900;
    font-size:18px;
    color:var(--pw-amber);
    margin-top:4px;
    font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;
  }

  .emi-banner{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:12px;
    background:var(--pw-amber);
    color:var(--pw-ink);
    border-radius:10px;
    padding:14px 18px;
    margin-top:22px;
    flex-wrap:wrap;
  }
  .emi-banner .emi-icon{
    font-family:var(--font-h);
    font-weight:900;
    font-size:14px;
    background:var(--pw-ink);
    color:var(--pw-amber);
    padding:6px 10px;
    border-radius:6px;
    white-space:nowrap;
  }
  .emi-banner p{
    margin:0;
    font-size:13px;
    font-weight:600;
    flex:1;
    min-width:200px;
  }
  .emi-banner p b{font-family:var(--font-h);}

  /* exchange details reveal */
  #exchangeDetails{
    margin-top:4px;
    padding:14px;
    background:var(--pw-surface);
    border:1px dashed var(--pw-border);
    border-radius:8px;
  }
  #exchangeDetails .field-row{margin-bottom:12px;}
  #exchangeDetails .field-row:last-child{margin-bottom:0;}
  .exchange-hint{
    font-size:11.5px;
    color:var(--pw-amber-deep);
    font-weight:600;
    margin-top:6px;
    display:block;
  }

  /* loyalty */
  .loyalty-box{
    display:flex;
    align-items:flex-start;
    gap:10px;
    background:rgba(255,152,0,0.08);
    border:1.5px solid rgba(255,152,0,0.35);
    border-radius:8px;
    padding:12px 14px;
    margin-bottom:16px;
  }
  .loyalty-box input{width:auto;margin-top:3px;flex:none;}
  .loyalty-box label{
    text-transform:none;
    font-weight:600;
    font-size:13px;
    color:var(--pw-ink);
    margin:0;
  }
  .loyalty-box .loyalty-tag{
    display:block;
    color:var(--pw-amber-deep);
    font-family:var(--font-h);
    font-weight:800;
    font-size:11px;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    margin-bottom:2px;
  }

  /* terms & conditions */
  .tnc-box{
    background:var(--pw-surface);
    border:1px solid var(--pw-border);
    border-radius:8px;
    padding:14px 16px;
    margin-bottom:16px;
  }
  .tnc-box summary{
    cursor:pointer;
    font-size:12.5px;
    font-weight:700;
    color:var(--pw-ink);
    list-style:none;
  }
  .tnc-box summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none;}
  .tnc-box summary::before{content:"📄 ";}
  .tnc-box ol{
    margin:12px 0 0;
    padding-left:18px;
    font-size:12px;
    color:var(--pw-muted);
    line-height:1.6;
  }
  .tnc-box li{margin-bottom:6px;}
  .tnc-agree{
    display:flex;
    align-items:flex-start;
    gap:10px;
    margin-bottom:16px;
  }
  .tnc-agree input{width:auto;margin-top:3px;flex:none;}
  .tnc-agree label{
    text-transform:none;
    font-weight:600;
    font-size:13px;
    color:var(--pw-ink);
    margin:0;
  }

  /* WhatsApp template modal */
  .wa-modal-overlay{
    position:fixed;
    inset:0;
    background:rgba(19,19,17,0.6);
    z-index:100;
    display:flex;
    align-items:flex-end;
    justify-content:center;
    padding:0;
  }
  .wa-modal-overlay[hidden]{display:none;}
  @media(min-width:640px){
    .wa-modal-overlay{align-items:center;padding:20px;}
  }
  .wa-modal{
    background:var(--pw-white);
    width:100%;
    max-width:440px;
    border-radius:16px 16px 0 0;
    padding:22px;
    max-height:80vh;
    overflow-y:auto;
  }
  @media(min-width:640px){
    .wa-modal{border-radius:16px;}
  }
  .wa-modal-head{
    display:flex;
    justify-content:space-between;
    align-items:center;
  }
  .wa-modal-head h4{
    font-size:16px;
    text-transform:none;
    letter-spacing:0;
  }
  .wa-modal-close{
    background:var(--pw-surface);
    border:none;
    width:30px;height:30px;
    border-radius:50%;
    font-size:18px;
    line-height:1;
    cursor:pointer;
    color:var(--pw-ink);
  }
  .wa-modal-sub{
    font-size:12.5px;
    color:var(--pw-muted);
    margin:8px 0 18px;
  }
  .wa-template-list{
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    gap:9px;
  }
  .wa-template{
    text-align:left;
    background:var(--pw-surface);
    border:1.5px solid var(--pw-border);
    border-radius:8px;
    padding:13px 14px;
    font-size:13.5px;
    font-weight:600;
    color:var(--pw-ink);
    cursor:pointer;
    font-family:var(--font-b);
  }
  .wa-template:hover{border-color:var(--pw-amber);background:#FFF4E5;}

  /* five reasons */
  .reason-grid{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:1fr;
    gap:14px;
  }
  @media(min-width:640px){ .reason-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;} }
  @media(min-width:960px){ .reason-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);} }
  .reason-card{
    border:1px solid var(--pw-border);
    border-radius:10px;
    padding:20px 16px;
    background:var(--pw-white);
  }
  .reason-num{
    font-family:var(--font-h);
    font-weight:900;
    font-size:20px;
    color:var(--pw-amber-deep);
    margin-bottom:8px;
  }
  .reason-card h4{
    font-size:14px;
    text-transform:none;
    letter-spacing:0;
  }
  .reason-card p{
    font-size:12.5px;
    color:var(--pw-muted);
    margin:6px 0 0;
    line-height:1.55;
  }

  .exchange-card{
    max-width:560px;
    background:var(--pw-surface);
    border:1px solid var(--pw-border);
    border-radius:14px;
    padding:24px;
  }

  /* quiz */
  .quiz-card{
    max-width:620px;
    background:var(--pw-white);
    border:1px solid var(--pw-border);
    border-radius:14px;
    padding:24px;
  }
  .quiz-q{margin-bottom:20px;}
  .quiz-result{
    margin-top:20px;
    background:var(--pw-ink);
    color:var(--pw-white);
    border-radius:12px;
    padding:20px;
    text-align:center;
  }
  .quiz-result-label{
    font-size:11.5px;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    letter-spacing:0.08em;
    color:#B9B9B4;
    margin:0;
  }
  .quiz-result-model{
    font-family:var(--font-h);
    font-weight:900;
    font-size:24px;
    color:var(--pw-amber);
    margin:6px 0;
  }
  .quiz-result-why{
    font-size:13px;
    color:#D8D8D4;
    margin:0 0 16px;
    line-height:1.6;
  }

  /* comparison table */
  .compare-cards{display:none;}
  @media(max-width:719px){
    .compare-wrap{display:none;}
    .compare-cards{
      display:grid;
      grid-template-columns:1fr;
      gap:14px;
    }
  }
  .compare-card{
    background:var(--pw-white);
    border:1px solid var(--pw-border);
    border-radius:12px;
    padding:18px;
  }
  .compare-card.featured{
    background:var(--pw-ink);
    border-color:var(--pw-ink);
    color:var(--pw-white);
  }
  .compare-card h4{font-size:15px;margin-bottom:10px;}
  .compare-card dl{margin:0;}
  .compare-card dl > div{
    display:flex;
    justify-content:space-between;
    gap:10px;
    padding:7px 0;
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--pw-border);
    font-size:12.5px;
  }
  .compare-card.featured dl > div{border-bottom-color:#2A2A26;}
  .compare-card dl > div:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
  .compare-card dt{color:var(--pw-muted);font-weight:600;}
  .compare-card.featured dt{color:#B9B9B4;}
  .compare-card dd{margin:0;font-weight:700;text-align:right;}
  .compare-wrap{overflow-x:auto;}
  .compare-table{
    width:100%;
    border-collapse:collapse;
    min-width:520px;
    background:var(--pw-white);
    border-radius:10px;
    overflow:hidden;
  }
  .compare-table th, .compare-table td{
    text-align:left;
    padding:13px 16px;
    font-size:13.5px;
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--pw-border);
  }
  .compare-table thead th{
    font-family:var(--font-h);
    font-weight:800;
    font-size:12px;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    letter-spacing:0.02em;
    background:var(--pw-ink);
    color:var(--pw-white);
    border-bottom:none;
  }
  .compare-table thead th:first-child{color:#B9B9B4;}
  .compare-table tbody td:first-child{
    font-weight:700;
    color:var(--pw-muted);
    font-size:12.5px;
  }
  .compare-table tbody tr:last-child td{border-bottom:none;}
  .compare-table tbody tr:nth-child(even){background:var(--pw-surface);}

  /* assist row */
  .assist-row{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
    gap:12px;
  }
  @media(min-width:720px){ .assist-row{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);} }
  .assist-card{
    text-align:center;
    padding:18px 12px;
    border:1px solid var(--pw-border);
    border-radius:10px;
  }
  .assist-card .assist-icon{font-size:22px;display:block;margin-bottom:8px;}
  .assist-card p{
    font-size:12.5px;
    font-weight:700;
    color:var(--pw-ink);
    margin:0;
  }

  /* area pills */
  .area-pills{
    display:flex;
    flex-wrap:wrap;
    gap:8px;
    margin-top:16px;
  }
  .area-pill{
    background:var(--pw-white);
    border:1px solid var(--pw-border);
    border-radius:999px;
    padding:6px 14px;
    font-size:12.5px;
    font-weight:600;
    color:var(--pw-ink);
  }

  /* why us */
  .why-grid{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);
    gap:14px;
  }
  @media(min-width:720px){ .why-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);} }
  .why-card{
    border:1px solid var(--pw-border);
    border-radius:10px;
    padding:18px 16px;
  }
  .why-num{
    font-family:var(--font-h);
    font-weight:900;
    font-size:22px;
    color:var(--pw-amber-deep);
  }
  .why-card h4{
    font-size:13px;
    margin-top:8px;
    text-transform:none;
    letter-spacing:0;
  }
  .why-card p{
    font-size:12.5px;
    color:var(--pw-muted);
    margin:6px 0 0;
    line-height:1.5;
  }

  /* testimonials */
  .testimonial-grid{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:1fr;
    gap:16px;
  }
  @media(min-width:640px){ .testimonial-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;} }
  @media(min-width:1000px){ .testimonial-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);} }
  .testimonial-card{
    background:var(--pw-white);
    border:1px solid var(--pw-border);
    border-radius:12px;
    padding:20px;
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    gap:12px;
  }
  .testimonial-stars{
    color:var(--pw-amber-deep);
    font-size:14px;
    letter-spacing:2px;
  }
  .testimonial-quote{
    font-size:13.5px;
    line-height:1.6;
    color:var(--pw-ink);
    margin:0;
    flex:1;
  }
  .testimonial-author{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:space-between;
    gap:8px;
    padding-top:10px;
    border-top:1px solid var(--pw-border);
  }
  .testimonial-name{
    font-family:var(--font-h);
    font-weight:800;
    font-size:12.5px;
    color:var(--pw-ink);
  }
  .testimonial-name span{
    display:block;
    font-family:var(--font-b);
    font-weight:600;
    font-size:11px;
    color:var(--pw-muted);
    text-transform:none;
    margin-top:2px;
  }
  .testimonial-src{
    font-size:10.5px;
    font-weight:700;
    color:#4285F4;
    white-space:nowrap;
  }

  /* steps */
  .steps{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:1fr;
    gap:16px;
  }
  @media(min-width:560px){ .steps{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;} }
  @media(min-width:960px){ .steps-5{grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);} }
  @media(min-width:720px) and (max-width:959px){ .steps-5{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;} }
  @media(min-width:960px){ .steps-4{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);} }
  @media(min-width:720px) and (max-width:959px){ .steps-4{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;} }
  .step{
    background:var(--pw-white);
    border:1px solid var(--pw-border);
    border-radius:10px;
    padding:20px;
    position:relative;
  }
  .step-num{
    font-family:var(--font-h);
    font-weight:900;
    font-size:13px;
    color:var(--pw-white);
    background:var(--pw-ink);
    width:28px;height:28px;
    border-radius:50%;
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    margin-bottom:12px;
  }
  .step h4{font-size:14.5px;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0;}
  .step p{font-size:13px;color:var(--pw-muted);margin:6px 0 0;line-height:1.55;}

  /* ---------- form ---------- */
  .form-section{
    background:var(--pw-surface);
  }
  .form-card{
    background:var(--pw-white);
    border:1px solid var(--pw-border);
    border-radius:14px;
    padding:26px;
    max-width:680px;
    margin:0 auto;
  }
  .form-card h3{
    font-size:19px;
    margin-bottom:4px;
  }
  .form-card .sub{
    font-size:13px;
    color:var(--pw-muted);
    margin-bottom:22px;
  }
  .form-steps-indicator{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    margin-bottom:24px;
  }
  .fsi-step{
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    align-items:center;
    gap:6px;
    flex:none;
  }
  .fsi-num{
    width:28px;height:28px;
    border-radius:50%;
    background:var(--pw-surface);
    border:1.5px solid var(--pw-border);
    color:var(--pw-muted);
    font-family:var(--font-h);
    font-weight:800;
    font-size:12.5px;
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  }
  .fsi-label{
    font-size:10px;
    font-weight:700;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    letter-spacing:0.03em;
    color:var(--pw-muted);
    white-space:nowrap;
  }
  .fsi-step.is-active .fsi-num{background:var(--pw-amber);border-color:var(--pw-amber);color:var(--pw-ink);}
  .fsi-step.is-active .fsi-label{color:var(--pw-ink);}
  .fsi-step.is-done .fsi-num{background:var(--pw-ink);border-color:var(--pw-ink);color:var(--pw-amber);}
  .fsi-line{
    flex:1;
    height:2px;
    background:var(--pw-border);
    margin:0 6px 18px;
  }
  .form-step .form-actions{justify-content:space-between;}
  .form-step .form-actions .btn{flex:1;}
  @media(min-width:480px){ .form-step .form-actions .btn{flex:none;} }
  .field-row{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:1fr;
    gap:14px;
    margin-bottom:14px;
  }
  @media(min-width:560px){ .field-row.two{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;} }
  label{
    display:block;
    font-size:12px;
    font-weight:700;
    letter-spacing:0.02em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--pw-ink);
    margin-bottom:6px;
  }
  label .req{color:var(--pw-amber-deep);}
  input[type=text],input[type=tel],select,textarea{
    width:100%;
    font-family:var(--font-b);
    font-size:14.5px;
    padding:11px 12px;
    border:1.5px solid var(--pw-border);
    border-radius:7px;
    background:var(--pw-white);
    color:var(--pw-ink);
  }
  input:focus,select:focus,textarea:focus{
    outline:2px solid var(--pw-amber);
    outline-offset:1px;
    border-color:var(--pw-amber);
  }
  fieldset{
    border:none;
    padding:0;margin:0;
  }
  .choice-group{
    display:flex;
    flex-wrap:wrap;
    gap:8px;
  }
  .choice{
    position:relative;
  }
  .choice input{
    position:absolute;
    opacity:0;
    width:100%;height:100%;
    cursor:pointer;
    margin:0;
  }
  .choice span{
    display:inline-flex;
    align-items:center;
    padding:9px 14px;
    border:1.5px solid var(--pw-border);
    border-radius:999px;
    font-size:13px;
    font-weight:600;
    background:var(--pw-white);
  }
  .choice input:checked + span{
    background:var(--pw-ink);
    border-color:var(--pw-ink);
    color:var(--pw-white);
  }
  .choice input:checked + span::before{
    content:"✓ ";
    color:var(--pw-amber);

  /* faq */

  .reason-card,.why-card,.store-card,.compare-card,.testimonial-card,.prod-card,.step,.assist-card{

  .reason-card:hover,.why-card:hover,.store-card:hover,.testimonial-card:hover,.assist-card:hover{

    border-color:var(--pw-amber);
  }
  .step:hover{
    transform:translateY(-3px);
    box-shadow:0 12px 28px -12px rgba(19,19,17,0.18);
  }
  .compare-card:hover{
    transform:translateY(-3px);
    box-shadow:0 14px 30px -14px rgba(19,19,17,0.22);
  }

  }
  .foot-brands{

  /* sticky mobile CTA */

    font-size:11.5px;

          <a class="store-action-link" href="tel:+919933301333">📞 Call</a>
          <button type="button" class="store-action-link store-select-btn" data-select-store="Gangtok Store, MG Marg, Sikkim">✓ Enquire at this store</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section style="background:var(--pw-surface);">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="section-head">
      <span class="kicker">Good to Know</span>
      <h2>Availability FAQs</h2>
      <p>Most-asked questions first — tap any question to expand.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="faq">
      <details class="faq-item" open>
        <summary><span class="faq-q"><span class="faq-tag">Most Asked</span>Is the iPhone 18 Pro / Pro Max in stock right now?</span></summary>
        <p>Stock changes daily and varies by model, colour, storage and store. Send us your preferred configuration on WhatsApp and our team will confirm current stock at your nearest store before you visit.</p>
      </details>
      <details class="faq-item">
        <summary><span class="faq-q"><span class="faq-tag">Most Asked</span>How quickly can I get my iPhone 18 Pro?</span></summary>
        <p>If your chosen configuration is in stock, same-day pickup is usually possible at your selected store. Home delivery availability and timing depend on your area - our team confirms both on enquiry.</p>
      </details>
      <details class="faq-item">
        <summary><span class="faq-q"><span class="faq-tag">Most Asked</span>How does the ₹1,000 loyalty discount work?</span></summary>
        <p>If you've purchased from Placewell before (any store, any product), tick the loyalty box in the form. Our team verifies your past purchase against our records and applies ₹1,000 off at billing — it isn't auto-applied on this page since we check it manually.</p>
      </details>
      <details class="faq-item">
        <summary><span class="faq-q"><span class="faq-tag">Most Asked</span>How does the cashback offer work?</span></summary>
        <p>Apple's official India store currently lists up to ₹15,000 instant cashback with American Express, Axis Bank or ICICI Bank cards (minimum transaction ₹10,001). The exact amount depends on your specific card. Tell us your bank in the form and we'll confirm the precise cashback for your card before billing — this page never asks for your card number or bank login.</p>
      </details>
      <details class="faq-item">
        <summary><span class="faq-q"><span class="faq-tag">Most Asked</span>Can I change my colour or storage choice later?</span></summary>
        <p>Yes - your selections here are preferences, not a confirmed order. Our team will confirm the exact available configuration with you on WhatsApp or by call before billing.</p>
      </details>
      <details class="faq-item">
        <summary>Do you offer EMI and exchange on iPhone 18 Pro?</summary>
        <p>Yes. No-Cost EMI is available for 3 &amp; 6 month tenures with most leading bank cards (subject to eligibility). For exchange, bring your old phone to any store — we evaluate it on the spot and offer the maximum trade-in value the market supports, adjusted directly against your new iPhone.</p>
      </details>
      <details class="faq-item">
        <summary>Do you offer home delivery?</summary>
        <p>Yes, in many areas we serve. Delivery availability, timing and any charges depend on your location and are confirmed by our team on WhatsApp before you pay.</p>
      </details>
      <details class="faq-item">
        <summary>Does it support dual SIM in India?</summary>
        <p>Yes — iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max support dual SIM as nano-SIM + eSIM, with dual eSIM also available (eSIM activation depends on your carrier). Per apple.com/in specifications.</p>
      </details>
      <details class="faq-item">
        <summary>What's in the box, and what's the warranty?</summary>
        <p>The box includes the iPhone (running iOS 27) and a USB-C Charge Cable (1m) — the power adapter is sold separately, as with recent iPhones. Every unit carries Apple's standard 1-year limited warranty in India; ask our team about extended AppleCare options.</p>
      </details>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<div class="wa-modal-overlay" id="waModalOverlay" hidden>
  <div class="wa-modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Choose a WhatsApp message">
    <div class="wa-modal-head">
      <h4>What would you like to ask?</h4>
      <button type="button" class="wa-modal-close" id="waModalClose" aria-label="Close">&times;</button>

    </div>

<script>
(function(){



  // ---------- Configurator ----------
  var PRICING = {
    'iPhone 18 Pro': {'256GB':164900,'512GB':189900,'1TB':239900,'2TB':314900},
    'iPhone 18 Pro Max': {'256GB':179900,'512GB':204900,'1TB':254900,'2TB':329900}
  };
  var COLOR_INFO = {
    black:{name:'Black',   hex:'#2b2b2b', dark:'#131311', img:'data:image/jpeg;base64,'},
    glacier:{name:'Glacier', hex:'#e9f2f2', dark:'#c3d6d6', img:'data:image/jpeg;base64,'},
    silver:{name:'Silver',  hex:'#f4f3ef', dark:'#cfcfc9', img:'data:image/jpeg;base64,'},
    burgundy:{name:'Burgundy',hex:'#6b2431', dark:'#3d141b', img:'data:image/jpeg;base64,'}
  };
  var MODEL_LABEL = { pro:'iPhone 18 Pro', promax:'iPhone 18 Pro Max' };
  var cfgState = { model:'pro', color:'black', storage:'256GB' };

  function formatINR(n){
    var x = Math.round(n).toString();
    var lastThree = x.substring(x.length - 3);
    var other = x.substring(0, x.length - 3);
    if (other !== '') { lastThree = ',' + lastThree; }
    var formattedOther = other.replace(/\B(?=(\d{2})+(?!\d))/g, ',');
    return '₹' + formattedOther + lastThree;
  }

  function updateConfigurator(){
    var modelLabel = MODEL_LABEL[cfgState.model] || MODEL_LABEL.pro;
    var c = COLOR_INFO[cfgState.color] || COLOR_INFO.black;

    var productImg = document.getElementById('cfgProductImg');
    var wrap = document.getElementById('cfgImgWrap');
    if(wrap){ wrap.setAttribute('data-color',cfgState.color); }
    if(productImg){
      productImg.classList.toggle('is-max', cfgState.model === 'promax');
      // Same labelled concept art illustrates both sizes; its display scale changes with model.
      if(productImg.getAttribute('src') !== c.img){ productImg.src = c.img; }
      productImg.alt = 'Promotional concept render illustrating ' + modelLabel + ' in ' + c.name;
    }
    var badge = document.getElementById('cfgModelBadge');
    if(badge){ badge.textContent = modelLabel; }
    var sizeNote = document.getElementById('cfgSizeNote');
    if(sizeNote){ sizeNote.textContent = (cfgState.model === 'promax' ? '6.9' : '6.3') + '" display · promotional render'; }

    var caption = document.getElementById('cfgCaption');
    if(caption){ caption.textContent = modelLabel + ' · ' + c.name + ' · ' + cfgState.storage; }
    var colorName = document.getElementById('cfgColorName');
    if(colorName){ colorName.textContent = c.name; }

    var priceEl = document.getElementById('cfgPrice');
    var currentPrice = (PRICING[modelLabel] && PRICING[modelLabel][cfgState.storage]) || null;
    if(priceEl){ priceEl.textContent = currentPrice ? formatINR(currentPrice) : 'Price unavailable — ask our team'; }

    var summaryLine = document.getElementById('cfgSummaryLine');
    if(summaryLine){
      summaryLine.textContent = modelLabel + ' · ' + c.name + ' · ' + cfgState.storage + ' · ' + (currentPrice ? formatINR(currentPrice) : 'price on request');
    }
    var summaryOffers = document.getElementById('cfgSummaryOffers');
    if(summaryOffers){
      summaryOffers.textContent = 'No-Cost EMI available · Up to ₹15,000 cashback may apply · ₹1,000 off for existing customers · All offers confirmed on enquiry';
    }
    var mobileCtaInfo = document.getElementById('mobileCtaInfo');
    if(mobileCtaInfo){
      mobileCtaInfo.textContent = modelLabel + ' · ' + c.name + ' · ' + (currentPrice ? formatINR(currentPrice) : 'price on request');
    }
    updateEmiCalculator(currentPrice);

    var cfgCta = document.getElementById('cfgCta');
    if(cfgCta){
      var message = 'Hi Placewell Retail, I would like to check the current price and availability of the ' + modelLabel + ' in ' + c.name + ', ' + cfgState.storage + '. Please confirm stock and offers.';
      cfgCta.setAttribute('href','https://wa.me/919933301333?text=' + encodeURIComponent(message));
      cfgCta.setAttribute('target','_blank');
      cfgCta.setAttribute('rel','noopener noreferrer');
    }

    // Keep the booking form in sync with the configurator
    var modelRadios = document.getElementsByName('model');
    for (var i = 0; i < modelRadios.length; i++){
      modelRadios[i].checked = (modelRadios[i].value === modelLabel);
    }
    var colorSelect = document.getElementById('fcolor');
    if (colorSelect){ colorSelect.value = c.name; }
    var storageSelect = document.getElementById('fstorage');
    if (storageSelect){ storageSelect.value = cfgState.storage; }
  }

  function wireSegGroup(groupId, stateKey, dataAttr){
    var group = document.getElementById(groupId);
    if(!group) return;
    group.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      var btn = e.target.closest('[data-' + dataAttr + ']');
      if(!btn) return;
      cfgState[stateKey] = btn.getAttribute('data-' + dataAttr);
      var siblings = group.querySelectorAll('.seg, .swatch');
      siblings.forEach(function(s){ s.classList.toggle('active', s === btn); s.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(s === btn)); });
      updateConfigurator();
    });
  }

  wireSegGroup('cfgModel', 'model', 'model');
  wireSegGroup('cfgColor', 'color', 'color');
  wireSegGroup('cfgStorage', 'storage', 'storage');
  ['cfgModel','cfgColor','cfgStorage'].forEach(function(id){document.querySelectorAll('#'+id+' button').forEach(function(btn){btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(btn.classList.contains('active')));});});
  updateConfigurator();

  // ---------- Cashback panel ----------
  var cashbackToggle = document.getElementById('cashbackToggle');
  var cashbackPanel = document.getElementById('cashbackPanel');
  if(cashbackToggle && cashbackPanel){
    cashbackToggle.addEventListener('click', function(){
      var isOpen = !cashbackPanel.hidden;
      cashbackPanel.hidden = isOpen;
      cashbackToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(!isOpen));
    });
  }

  // ---------- No-Cost EMI calculator ----------
  var emiToggle = document.getElementById('emiToggle');
  var emiPanel = document.getElementById('emiPanel');
  if(emiToggle && emiPanel){
    emiToggle.addEventListener('click', function(){
      var isOpen = !emiPanel.hidden;
      emiPanel.hidden = isOpen;
      emiToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(!isOpen));
    });
  }
  function updateEmiCalculator(price){
    var amt3 = document.getElementById('emiAmt3');
    var amt6 = document.getElementById('emiAmt6');
    if(!price){
      if(amt3) amt3.textContent = 'Ask us';
      if(amt6) amt6.textContent = 'Ask us';
      return;
    }
    if(amt3) amt3.textContent = formatINR(price / 3) + '/mo';
    if(amt6) amt6.textContent = formatINR(price / 6) + '/mo';
  }

  // ---------- 3-step enquiry form wizard ----------
  function goToFormStep(stepNum){
    document.querySelectorAll('.form-step').forEach(function(panel){
      panel.hidden = (panel.getAttribute('data-step') !== String(stepNum));
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('.fsi-step').forEach(function(fsi){
      var n = parseInt(fsi.getAttribute('data-fsi'), 10);
      fsi.classList.toggle('is-active', n === stepNum);
      fsi.classList.toggle('is-done', n < stepNum);
    });
    var indicator = document.getElementById('formStepsIndicator');
    if(indicator) indicator.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'start'});
  }
  var step1Next = document.getElementById('step1Next');
  var step2Next = document.getElementById('step2Next');
  var step2Back = document.getElementById('step2Back');
  var step3Back = document.getElementById('step3Back');
  if(step1Next) step1Next.addEventListener('click', function(){ goToFormStep(2); });
  if(step2Next) step2Next.addEventListener('click', function(){ goToFormStep(3); });
  if(step2Back) step2Back.addEventListener('click', function(){ goToFormStep(1); });
  if(step3Back) step3Back.addEventListener('click', function(){ goToFormStep(2); });
  // Prevent an accidental Enter-key submit while on steps 1 or 2
  var pbFormEl = document.getElementById('pbForm');
  if(pbFormEl){
    pbFormEl.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
      if(e.key !== 'Enter') return;
      var step3Panel = pbFormEl.querySelector('.form-step[data-step="3"]');
      var onStep3 = step3Panel && !step3Panel.hidden;
      if(!onStep3 && e.target.tagName !== 'TEXTAREA'){
        e.preventDefault();
      }
    });
  }

  // ---------- Exchange details reveal ----------
  var exchangeSelect = document.getElementById('fexchange');
  var exchangeDetails = document.getElementById('exchangeDetails');
  if(exchangeSelect && exchangeDetails){
    exchangeSelect.addEventListener('change', function(){
      exchangeDetails.hidden = (exchangeSelect.value === 'No');
    });
  }

  // ---------- Reliable WhatsApp opener ----------
  // window.open() is silently blocked by many mobile browsers / in-app
  // webviews / sandboxed iframes -- it returns null instead of throwing,
  // so code right after it (like closing a modal) still runs, making it
  // LOOK like the click worked while WhatsApp never opens. Simulating a
  // real anchor click is treated as a genuine link navigation instead of
  // a popup, so it is not blocked the same way.
  function openWhatsApp(url){
    try {
      var a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url;
      a.target = '_blank';
      a.rel = 'noopener noreferrer';
      a.style.display = 'none';
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      document.body.removeChild(a);
    } catch(err){
      // Absolute last resort fallback
      window.location.href = url;
    }
  }

  // ---------- Which iPhone quiz ----------
  var quizSubmit = document.getElementById('quizSubmit');
  if(quizSubmit){
    quizSubmit.addEventListener('click', function(){
      var q1 = document.querySelector('input[name="quizQ1"]:checked');
      var q2 = document.querySelector('input[name="quizQ2"]:checked');
      var q3 = document.querySelector('input[name="quizQ3"]:checked');
      if(!q1 || !q2 || !q3){
        alert('Please answer all 3 questions to see your recommendation.');
        return;
      }
      var score = parseInt(q1.value,10) + parseInt(q2.value,10) + parseInt(q3.value,10);
      var recommendPromax = score >= 2;
      var resultBox = document.getElementById('quizResult');
      var resultModel = document.getElementById('quizResultModel');
      var resultWhy = document.getElementById('quizResultWhy');
      if(recommendPromax){
        resultModel.textContent = 'iPhone 18 Pro Max';
        resultWhy.textContent = 'Based on your answers, the bigger 6.9" display, longer battery life and top-tier camera/video make the Pro Max the better fit.';
      } else {
        resultModel.textContent = 'iPhone 18 Pro';
        resultWhy.textContent = 'Based on your answers, the more compact 6.3" Pro gives you the same A20 Pro chip and camera system in an easier-to-hold size.';
      }
      resultBox.hidden = false;
      resultBox.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'center'});

      // Sync the configurator to the recommended model
      var targetModelKey = recommendPromax ? 'promax' : 'pro';
      var cfgModelGroup = document.getElementById('cfgModel');
      if(cfgModelGroup){
        var btn = cfgModelGroup.querySelector('[data-model="' + targetModelKey + '"]');
        if(btn) btn.click();
      }
    });
  }

  // ---------- Store card "Enquire at this store" ----------
  document.querySelectorAll('.store-select-btn').forEach(function(btn){
    btn.addEventListener('click', function(){
      var storeName = btn.getAttribute('data-select-store');
      var storeSelect = document.getElementById('fstore');
      if(storeSelect){ storeSelect.value = storeName; }
      var formSection = document.getElementById('enquiry-form');
      if(formSection){ formSection.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'start'}); }
      goToFormStep(2);
    });
  });

  // ---------- Quick exchange value estimator ----------
  var exvSubmit = document.getElementById('exvSubmit');
  if(exvSubmit){
    exvSubmit.addEventListener('click', function(){
      var brand = document.getElementById('exvBrand').value.trim();
      var condition = document.getElementById('exvCondition').value;
      if(!brand){
        document.getElementById('exvBrand').focus();
        return;
      }
      var msg = 'Hi Placewell, I want to know the exchange value for my old phone: ' + brand + ' (' + condition + '). I am looking to upgrade to an iPhone 18 Pro / Pro Max.';
      if(typeof fbq === 'function'){ fbq('track', 'Contact', {content_name: 'Exchange Value Enquiry'}); }
      openWhatsApp('https://wa.me/919933301333?text=' + encodeURIComponent(msg));
    });
  }

  // ---------- WhatsApp template modal ----------
  var WA_NUMBER_GLOBAL = '919933301333';
  var waOverlay = document.getElementById('waModalOverlay');
  var waClose = document.getElementById('waModalClose');
  var waTemplateList = document.getElementById('waTemplateList');

  function openWaTemplates(){ if(waOverlay){ waOverlay.hidden = false; } }
  function closeWaTemplates(){ if(waOverlay){ waOverlay.hidden = true; } }

  document.querySelectorAll('[data-wa-trigger]').forEach(function(btn){
    btn.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      e.preventDefault();
      openWaTemplates();
    });
  });
  if(waClose){ waClose.addEventListener('click', closeWaTemplates); }
  if(waOverlay){
    waOverlay.addEventListener('click', function(e){ if(e.target === waOverlay){ closeWaTemplates(); } });
  }
  if(waTemplateList){
    waTemplateList.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      var btn = e.target.closest('.wa-template');
      if(!btn) return;
      var msg = btn.getAttribute('data-msg');
      if(typeof fbq === 'function'){ fbq('track', 'Contact', {content_name: 'WhatsApp Quick Message'}); }
      openWhatsApp('https://wa.me/' + WA_NUMBER_GLOBAL + '?text=' + encodeURIComponent(msg));
      closeWaTemplates();
    });
  }

  // Form -> WhatsApp deep link
  var form = document.getElementById('pbForm');
  var msgBox = document.getElementById('formMsg');
  var waFallback = document.getElementById('waFallback');
  var WA_NUMBER = '919933301333';

  function showErr(id, show){
    var n = document.getElementById(id);
    if(n) n.classList.toggle('show', !!show);
  }

  var lastEnquiryAt = 0;
  function handleEnquiry(e){
    if(e){ e.preventDefault(); }
    var nowMs = Date.now();
    if(nowMs - lastEnquiryAt < 800){ return; }
    lastEnquiryAt = nowMs;
    var name = form.fname.value.trim();
    var phoneRaw = form.fphone.value.trim();
    var phoneDigits = phoneRaw.replace(/\D/g,'');
    var validName = name.length > 1;
    var validPhone = /^[6-9]\d{9}$/.test(phoneDigits) || (phoneDigits.length === 12 && phoneDigits.slice(0,2) === '91' && /^[6-9]/.test(phoneDigits.slice(2)));
    var tncAccepted = form.ftnc.checked;

    showErr('err-fname', !validName);
    showErr('err-fphone', !validPhone);
    showErr('err-ftnc', !tncAccepted);
    if(!validName || !validPhone || !tncAccepted){
      if(!tncAccepted){ document.getElementById('err-ftnc').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'center'}); }
      return;
    }

    var model = form.model.value;
    var color = form.fcolor.value;
    var storage = form.fstorage.value;
    var store = form.fstore.value;
    var area = form.farea.value.trim();
    var exchange = form.fexchange.value;
    var payment = form.fpayment.value;
    var bank = form.fbank.value;
    var loyalty = form.floyalty.checked;
    var notes = form.fnotes.value.trim();

    var lines = [
      'Hi Placewell Retail, I would like to check availability of the ' + model + ' (now available).',
      'Name: ' + name,
      'Mobile: ' + phoneRaw,
      'Colour preference: ' + color,
      'Storage preference: ' + storage,
      'Pickup / delivery: ' + store
    ];
    if(area){ lines.push('Area / PIN: ' + area); }
    lines.push('Exchange old phone: ' + exchange);
    if (exchange !== 'No'){
      var exBrand = form.fexbrand.value.trim();
      var exCondition = form.fexcondition.value;
      if(exBrand){ lines.push('Old phone: ' + exBrand + ' (' + exCondition + ') — please quote maximum exchange value'); }
    }
    if (PRICING[model] && PRICING[model][storage]){
      lines.push('Indicative price (team to confirm): ' + formatINR(PRICING[model][storage]));
    }
    lines.push('Payment preference: ' + payment);
    if (bank && bank !== 'Not using a card / no preference'){
      lines.push('Cashback card: ' + bank + ' — please confirm exact cashback amount');
    }
    if (loyalty){
      lines.push('Loyalty discount claimed: Yes, existing Placewell customer — please verify and apply ₹1,000 off');
    }
    lines.push('I accept the Purchase & Enquiry Terms on this page.');
    if(notes){ lines.push('Notes: ' + notes); }

    var text = encodeURIComponent(lines.join('\n'));
    var waLink = 'https://wa.me/' + WA_NUMBER + '?text=' + text;

    waFallback.setAttribute('href', waLink);
    msgBox.classList.add('show');
    msgBox.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'center'});

    if(typeof fbq === 'function'){
      fbq('track', 'Lead', {
        content_name: model,
        content_category: 'iPhone 18 Availability Enquiry',
        value: (PRICING[model] && PRICING[model][storage]) ? PRICING[model][storage] : 0,
        currency: 'INR'
      });
    }
    openWhatsApp(waLink);
  }
  form.addEventListener('submit', handleEnquiry);
  // Some sandboxed webviews block form submission entirely - trigger the same
  // handler from the submit button's click, guarded against double-firing.
  var enquiryBtn = form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
  if(enquiryBtn){ enquiryBtn.addEventListener('click', handleEnquiry); }

})();
</script>

</body>
</html>
